Hi Lena 

Thanks again for the time earlier  appreciate the context on GreenWave's usage patterns and the pilot goals. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Recap from call:
- Pilot scope: 10k requests/month for customer support summaries + embeddings for search.
- Latency SLO target: 200250ms P50 for generation paths.
- Data controls: SOC 2 + optional VPC for production.

Commercial & procurement notes I wanted to confirm:
- Preferred payment method: PO (invoice) vs card? You mentioned procurement prefers PO for >$25k.
- Marketplace interest: would procurement prefer acquiring via Azure Marketplace (shows up on their cloud spend) or a direct Redwood contract?
- Paperwork: procurement asked for an SOW + invoice template. I can send both  see attached pricing doc and draft SOW.

Proposed next steps:
1) Ill attach the updated pricing sheet and a SOW template for your review (attached).
2) If PO path: let me know the billing contact + billing address and any required PO language.
3) If marketplace: Ill confirm listing details and lead time for procurement sign-off.
4) Weekly 15-min check-in starting next Wed (6/17) to track where its stuck.

Are you available for a quick alignment call on 6/17 at 10am PT? If not, propose a time that works.

Thanks  Ill stand by and get the SOW over right away.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Thanks for the recap and the attachments. Quick answers from procurement side:
- Procurement prefers a PO for anything that will be annual spend and >$25k. Pilot is expected to roll into an annual contract, so PO is likely.
- Marketplace: we generally prefer to buy through our cloud marketplace when possible because it flows through our existing cloud budget  can you confirm if Redwood is on Azure Marketplace or if there's a plan to be?
- Paperwork: procurement will need an SOW + an invoice template; also need to see standard security docs (SOC 2).

Im looped in with Jack Turner (IT procurement)  hell be the one raising the PO. Jack, copying you to flag  do you have the typical PO language we need?
